headline: Train Wait Nearing End for Dhar; Only 200 Metres of Track Left in 3 KM Long Teehi Tunnel… Work Reaches Final Stage
summary: Only 200 metres of track remain to be laid in the roughly 3 km Teehi Tunnel on the Indore-Dahod rail line. Railways have accelerated work by running it in two shifts to bring trains to Dhar.
why: Rail links support freight and passenger movement and regional economic development, making major rail projects relevant to infrastructure investors and builders in India.
